title: Capability artifact
description: A recorded, parameterised capability. Discovery compiles a trace into one of these; replay executes it with no model in the loop. The schema is the instruction set: replay can only do what a step can express, so anything absent here is deliberately out of scope. Validated on save and on load.

schema_version.description: Format version of this file. Distinct from capability.version, which versions the recording.

version.description: Semver of the recording. patch: re-recorded same flow. minor: new optional outputs. major: inputs or outputs changed.

description.description: What this capability does, in one sentence. Required because a calling agent reads it to decide whether to invoke.

requires_secrets.description: Names of credentials this flow needs, resolved from the environment at run time. Names only — values never enter an artifact (see policy: redaction). A step references one as {secrets.name}.

app.description: Stable routing key for the application. Never changes across versions; groups capabilities and scopes recovery routines.

app_fingerprint.description: app@build, scraped from the application itself at discovery time. Expected to change; a mismatch at replay raises a drift warning.

discovery_run_id.description: Back-reference to the evidence directory for the discovery run that produced this artifact.

inputs.description: Parameters the calling agent supplies per invocation. A step references one as {inputs.name}.

pattern.description: Regex the value must match. Checked before the browser opens, so a malformed input fails cheaply instead of halfway through a mutation.

outputs.description: Typed values this capability returns. Each is filled by exactly one read step.

source_step.description: id of the read step that produces this value. Referential integrity is checked by the validator, which JSON Schema cannot express.

parse.description: How to coerce the observed string into `type`. 'currency' strips symbols and separators.

expected_outcomes.description: Business outcomes declared up front, not discovered at run time. This is what keeps 'no such member' from ever being a crash. An empty array is a deliberate claim that this flow has no non-failure outcomes — make it on purpose.

code.description: Stable code the calling agent branches on.

meaning.description: Why this is a legitimate result rather than a failure. Required: if you cannot say why, it is a failure.

checkpoint.description: The success evidence the agent named at discovery time. Replay reports SUCCESS only if this holds.

identifier.description: snake_case name, safe to use as a key in any calling language.

condition.description: A cheap, deterministic assertion about observed state. Two kinds only: page content, and where we landed — the two things a step can assert without re-reasoning about the UI.

strategy.description: One way to locate a target. Recorded in fallback order; replay tries each in turn and logs which one won, which is drift telemetry for free.

role.description: Interactive role (textbox, button, link...) to disambiguate a repeated label.

value.description: CSS or XPath-ish path. Exact today, brittle to layout edits.

verify_text_nearby.description: Required, not optional: never click blind. If this text is not where it was, the coordinates are stale and the strategy fails instead of clicking whatever moved there.

strategies.description: Ordered by preference, most stable first.

frame.description: URL or path of the frame this target lives in. Absent means the main document.

step.description: One replayable action. Fields are action-specific and enforced below, so a step cannot be half-formed: a navigate without a checkpoint, or a read that does not say what it fills, is invalid.

action.description: The agent's `done` and `stuck` tools are loop control, not replayable actions, so they are deliberately absent here.

risk.description: Required on every step. read_only auto-allows; mutating needs --approve-mutations; irreversible always pauses for a human.

reason.description: Why the agent took this step. Carried for reviewability; replay ignores it.

output.description: read only. Which declared output this step fills.
